name: Minnitaki Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from an unrecorded-year MNRF transect survey (SURVEY_YEAR is 0/null in the LIO bathymetry index records and feature dates are null). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 51.8 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (83.2% of water cells at >=0.4). Cold-regime lake; lake trout, sauger and cisco in the ARA community. Secchi 4 m is a FALLBACK default (ARA Secchi null).
